## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally (lint, types, tests, build, dist check)
- [ ] `dist/` was rebuilt and committed if `src/` changed
- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit, or an eval case for skill behavior)
- [ ] New platform rules cite an official source in `src/export/specs.ts`
- [ ] No private brand material, keys or real customer data in the diff
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
